notes:
Account summary: Chargeflow Labs builds subscription billing and dunning automation for mid-market SaaS. Product team (CTO=Rina Kaur, Head of Ops=Ben Ortiz) evaluating Redwood to power a customer-facing billing assistant + internal support agent. Primary goal: reduce time-to-resolution for payment disputes and automate invoice queries via Stripe/Zuora integrations.

Key requirements + signals:
- Workload: chat/agent for support + webhook-backed tool-calls to Stripe / Zuora; bot must return structured JSON (invoice_id, status, next_action, amount_due, links[]) for downstream ticketing.
- Latency SLO: p95 response <= 250-300ms for single-turn queries (streaming acceptable for long flows). Must support streaming tokens to UX for faster perceived latency.
- Tool calling: need robust function/tool patterns + retries; want first-class plugin to call our billing microservices and return JSON schemas.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching, KV caching) to reduce per-token costs.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs for every invocation, KMS for key material, and EU data residency for EU customers. Will require SOC2 docs before procurement.
- Model preference: open-ish Llama-family variant with tool-calling and fallback to smaller model for low-cost intents. Also interested in dedicated capacity for predictable latency at scale.

Recent discussions/quotes:
- "We need streaming for the agent so customers see immediate progress — p95 is make-or-break." — Ben O.
- Engineering: "We'll wire tool-calls to Stripe webhooks; response must be strict JSON for automated reconciliation." — Rina K.

POC plan (agreed):
- Week 0: baseline demo (hosted API) + streaming/tool-calling proof of concept using sample Stripe sandbox data.
- Week 1-3: integrate hosted endpoints into staging support console, capture p50/p95 latency, token usage, error rates. Redwood SE to provide perf profile.
- Week 4: evaluate results; if latency/cost acceptable, move to pricing for Dedicated reserved pool (target commit).

Open items for AE/SE:
- Provide SOC2/ISO evidence (SEC-441).
- Deliver sample JSON schema for tool outputs and a reference streaming demo (INF-1324).
- Confirm Dedicated instance sizing and estimated monthly cost for target throughput (10 RPS peak, 800k tokens/month).
